gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption reads wide-bodied and inviting, its bowls left unclosed. Under Galaxy's loose, unbroken lines, a long stretch of text would feel contemporary and easy to settle into without tiring.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-puritan: Rounded, friendly and a bit spacey, Puritan sits under Galaxy's unbroken, pinch-free lines. Galaxy is best at striking a cosmic pose; Puritan is best at staying open and approachable.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-questrial: Modern and crisp, Galaxy stretches its loosely spaced, tall lowercase across the top. Questrial follows in sans-serif with open shapes and a flat, stencil-cut feel, giving the display lines something level to lean on.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-radio-canada: Tall, full and unfussy, that's the look of Radio Canada. Radio Canada keeps a steady line with no pressure shifts, so a long passage under Galaxy's wide spacing moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-radio-canada-big: Galaxy draws every letter in one unbroken line width, with a dense lowercase band and generous spacing. Radio Canada Big's sans-serif x-height fills the line.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-readex-pro: Professional in tone, Readex Pro keeps a steady weight from word to word, with broad gaps at its terminals. And Galaxy handles the cosmic, commanding side, its loose spacing giving the sans below plenty of room to work.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ruda: Galaxy's uninterrupted line width gives it the look of bent wire, loosely spaced and tall in the lowercase. Ruda's sizable x-height and wide-mouthed rounds make longer text feel friendly.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-saira: Galaxy has a texture like neatly bent pipe cleaner, loosely spaced and dense in its tall lowercase. Saira's see-through s and high, rounded letters do the quieter work.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sarpanch: Cosmic lines, friendly text. Sarpanch has a clearly open e and a compact gap up to its ascenders, so it holds up at a modest size beneath Galaxy's uppercase of constant thickness.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-savate: Clean and contemporary, Savate pairs open curves with a tall rounded o. Galaxy's flat, fineliner-like line and loose spacing sit above it, while Savate's modest stroke modulation adds a gentler texture.
